text: 1258 introduces incoming edited tracking. Accepted setState keeps the existing edited flag, captureState includes it, and resetState clears it. The controller reset walks subviews and invokes their resetState methods. A scoped recommendation is to preserve the distinction between revisiting a form and starting a fresh Hub flow; clearing edited merely because fields are restored can re-enable a continuation that still requires retesting. This is source and test inspection only. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran.
title: Retain the incoming edited flag across state updates and clear it during reset
